ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RS-2,
Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) Districts; RS-3, Residential Single-Unit
(Detached House) District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 28-F in the area
bound by:

South Normal Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to West 111th Street; South
Stewart Avenue; and West 112'" Street,

to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

i L. Mosley ag

Alderman, 21% Ward

Common Address:

11115 - 11157 S. Normal Avenue
11114 - 11154 S. Eggleston Avenue
11115 - 11157 S. Eggleston Avenue
11114 - 11148 S. Stewart Avenue
406-410 W. 112" Street
